spells.where: next to the spell name in lists and on spell cards
spells.palette: plus one accent color that fits the spell's magic
spells.composition: a single iconic motif centered and filling about 70% of the frame
spells.isolation: no figures' faces in detail, hands or objects are fine
spells.heading: Spells:

monsters.where: next to the monster name in lists, encounter tables and on monster cards
monsters.palette: with each creature in its own canonical colors
monsters.composition: the single creature centered and filling about 80% of the frame, with dramatic warm side lighting
monsters.isolation: the creature alone, no other figures, no opponents, no environment
monsters.heading: Monsters:

items.where: next to the item name in inventories, shop lists and on item cards
items.palette: with each object in its own material colors; magic shown with one fitting accent color
items.composition: the single object centered and filling about 75% of the frame, warm side lighting
items.isolation: the object alone, no hands, no people, no table or surface
items.heading: Items:

feats.where: next to the feat name in lists and on feat cards
feats.palette: plus one accent color that fits the feat
feats.composition: a single iconic motif centered and filling about 70% of the frame
feats.isolation: no figures' faces in detail, hands or objects are fine
feats.heading: Feats:
